title: His sister Peggy and the call from Duke Ellington
summary: Peggy recorded with Gerald Wilson and got a Las Vegas offer from Ellington after making 'instant success' magic.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: You said also that your sister sang with Duke Ellington.
Was that out here? Or did she tour?

My sister was something. She had this thing going where she was into magic and stuff. I went over to her house one time, and she says – I said, “What are you doing?” She said, “I’m making a – I getting ready to do something special.” She says, “I’m making something called instant success.” I said, “Instant success. Really?” She says, yeah. She got through. She says, “Now watch.” About two hours went by. Then the phone rang, and Duke Ellington was on the phone from Las Vegas. He says, “Please come down and sing with the band.” I said, “Oh my gosh.” She says, “See, look: instant success. I got a gig with Duke.”
